# Protocol Ward — demo tracker blocklist.
#
# This is a HAND-CURATED demonstration list of ~40 well-known ad, analytics,
# and tracker hostnames. It exists so the README gif and local testing have
# recognizable adversaries to block — not as a production blocklist.
#
# For production use, point ward at a maintained public list:
#
#   wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StevenBlack/hosts/master/hosts \
#        -O blocklists/stevenblack.hosts
#   # then add to ward.yaml:
#   #   blocklists:
#   #     - id: "stevenblack"
#   #       path: "./blocklists/stevenblack.hosts"
#
# Other widely-used sources:
#   - Pi-hole's default lists: https://github.com/pi-hole/pi-hole/blob/master/automated%20install/listsofadlists.txt
#   - OISD: https://oisd.nl/
#   - The Block List Project: https://github.com/blocklistproject
#
# Format is /etc/hosts ("0.0.0.0 <hostname>"). internal/hostlist/parser.go
# also accepts the AdAway short form ("0 <hostname>") and the AdGuard bare
# form ("||hostname^") — see the parser docstring for the full grammar.
#
# Entries below are alphabetized within category for ease of audit.

# --- Google ad/analytics stack ---
